Job Summary

The Legal Counsel: General Business role provides expert legal advice and counsel across a broad spectrum of business law areas, ensuring the organization's legal rights and obligations are upheld. This role is responsible for researching, analyzing, and interpreting legal matters, identifying potential risks, and developing strategies to mitigate them. A primary purpose is to structure, draft, negotiate, and approve a variety of legal documents, including contracts and policies, to protect the company's interests. Key areas of focus include corporate law, business law, customer protection law, electronic transaction law, intellectual property, employment law, anti-competition law, personnal data protection, AI and technology law, and compliance, often involving representation in dispute resolution processes. This position requires a qualified lawyer with admission to practice law, capable of both internal counsel and liaising with external legal resources on complex matters.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Law (S.H.) from a reputable Indonesian university. Holding an active Indonesian Advocates Association (PERADI) license is highly preferred and considered a distinct advantage.
• Professional Experience: Minimum of 7–10 years of post-qualification legal experience, with a proven track record in a reputable corporate law firm (top-tier preferred) and/or as senior in-house counsel in a fast-paced corporate environment or high-growth industry.
• Leadership & Team Management: At least 2–3 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial capacity, demonstrating a strong track record of leading legal teams, mentoring junior/officer-level counsels, and driving cross-functional legal projects.
• Subject Matter & Regulatory Expertise: Comprehensive working knowledge across key legal domains, including:Commercial & Contract Law (complex multi-party partnerships, revenue-sharing models, and strategic procurement/sales);Consumer Protection (Law No. 8/1999) and Advertising Standards (Etika Pariwara Indonesia);Competition & Antitrust Law (Law No. 5/1999 and KPPU regulatory practices);Personal Data Protection (Law No. 27/2022) and Electronic Information & Transactions (UU ITE);Telecommunications regulatory framework (Komdigi regulations, licensing, tariff policies, and KYC/registration requirements);Dispute resolution mechanisms (negotiation, mediation, BPSK proceedings, and formal litigation/arbitration);Familiarity with emerging AI governance, digital intellectual property, and technology law.
• Behavioral Attributes & Leadership:Commercial Enabler Mindset: A pragmatic, business-oriented problem-solver who effectively balances robust legal safeguards with commercial urgency.Decisiveness & Tough-Mindedness: Composed, resilient, and decisive under tight Go-To-Market (GTM) deadlines and high-stakes commercial negotiations.
• Operational Readiness: Willingness and physical capability to travel across Indonesian regions/circles for on-ground commercial reviews, dealer audits, local stakeholder alignments, and dispute hearings.
• Language & Productivity Tools: Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia. Proficient in contract lifecycle management systems, legal research platforms, and the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Key Responsibilities

Workflow

Key Responsibility

Legal Advisory and Consultation

Ensure the quality and accuracy of legal advice provided to the organization, especially to the Commercial team.

Legal Research and Analysis

Ensure the thoroughness and accuracy of legal research and analysis conducted by the team.

Contract Management and Negotiation

Ensure the legal soundness and commercial viability of all contracts, providing final approval and oversight of the contract lifecycle.

Risk Identification and Mitigation

Ensure the effectiveness of risk mitigation strategies across the organization.

Policy Development and Implementation

Ensure the consistent application of legal standards and improved organizational governance.

Dispute Resolution and Litigation Support

Ensure the effective resolution of legal disputes through appropriate strategies and oversight.

Compliance Monitoring and Reporting

Proactively identify and remediate compliance gaps, ensuring adherence to legal requirements and internal policies.

Skills

• Legal Research & Professional Writing
• Corporate Governance & Corrective Action
• Internal Controls & Reporting
• Regulatory Compliance & Programme Development
• Contract Law & Commercial Negotiation
• Litigation & Dispute Resolution
• Enterprise Risk Assessment & Analysis
• Stakeholder Communication & Training
• Audit Execution & Data Analytics
• Evidence & Records Management
• Audit Strategy & Planning
• Forensic Investigation & Due Diligence
• Financial Crime & Ethical Compliance

Power House Operator

Location: Singkawang, West Kalimantan
Company: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk

Job Description

Key Responsibilities
Utility Operations
• Operate and monitor boilers to ensure adequate steam supply for pelleting machines according to production requirements.
• Operate and oversee air compressors to maintain a continuous supply of compressed air for production equipment.
• Operate generators during power outages to ensure uninterrupted production activities.
• Operate and maintain water pumps to support production processes and facility operations.
• Operate the hot water system to maintain palm olein at the required temperature for production use.
• Operate and ensure the readiness of hydrant pumps as part of the plant fire protection system.

Monitoring and Reporting
• Record and monitor operational parameters of all power house equipment.
• Calculate and record electricity, boiler fuel (diesel), water consumption, and other utility usage.
• Prepare daily boiler operation reports, including diesel consumption, water usage, steam pressure, hour meter readings, and blowdown activities.
• Prepare daily electricity consumption reports, including voltage, current (ampere), and energy consumption (kWh).
• Prepare generator usage reports, including diesel consumption, engine temperature, oil pressure, voltage, and current readings.
• Prepare autonomous maintenance reports for power house equipment.

Maintenance and Preventive Care
• Clean boiler fire tubes/flue passages to maintain optimal heat transfer efficiency.
• Perform routine cleaning of feed water tanks and water storage tanks to ensure water quality.
• Conduct regeneration of the soft water treatment system to maintain proper boiler feed water quality.
• Perform routine boiler water quality inspections and testing.
• Carry out scheduled oil and filter replacements on equipment.
• Conduct periodic generator warm-up activities to ensure operational readiness.
• Report abnormalities, equipment failures, or unsafe conditions to supervisors promptly.

Housekeeping, Safety & Compliance
• Maintain cleanliness of machines, equipment, and the power house work area.
• Comply with Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) regulations, environmental standards, and company policies.
• Ensure all operational activities are conducted in accordance with established SOPs, work instructions, and regulatory requirements.

Power House Operator

Location: Singkawang, Kalimantan Barat
Company: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk

Job Description

Key Responsibilities
Operasional Utility
• Mengoperasikan dan memonitor boiler untuk memastikan ketersediaan steam bagi mesin pelleting sesuai kebutuhan produksi.
• Mengoperasikan dan mengawasi compressor untuk menjaga kontinuitas suplai udara bertekanan ke mesin produksi.
• Mengoperasikan genset saat terjadi gangguan atau pemadaman listrik untuk memastikan kegiatan operasional tetap berjalan.
• Mengoperasikan dan menjaga sistem pompa air guna menjamin ketersediaan air untuk kebutuhan produksi maupun fasilitas pendukung.
• Mengoperasikan sistem hot water untuk pemanasan palm olein agar tetap dalam kondisi sesuai standar penggunaan produksi.
• Menjalankan dan memastikan kesiapan pompa hydrant sebagai bagian dari sistem proteksi kebakaran.

Monitoring dan Pelaporan
• Melakukan pencatatan dan monitoring parameter operasional seluruh peralatan power house.
• Melakukan perhitungan dan pencatatan penggunaan listrik, bahan bakar boiler (solar), air, dan utilitas lainnya.
• Menyusun laporan harian boiler yang mencakup konsumsi bahan bakar, penggunaan air, tekanan steam, hour meter, dan aktivitas blowdown.
• Menyusun laporan harian pemakaian listrik meliputi tegangan, arus (ampere), dan konsumsi energi (kWh).
• Menyusun laporan penggunaan genset yang mencakup konsumsi solar, temperatur mesin, tekanan oli, tegangan listrik, dan arus listrik.
• Menyusun laporan perawatan mandiri (autonomous maintenance) terhadap peralatan di area power house.

Perawatan dan Pemeliharaan
• Melakukan pembersihan lorong api boiler untuk menjaga efisiensi perpindahan panas.
• Melakukan pembersihan feed water tank dan tandon air secara berkala guna menjaga kualitas air operasional.
• Melaksanakan regenerasi soft water system untuk memastikan kualitas air umpan boiler sesuai standar.
• Melakukan pengecekan kualitas air boiler secara rutin.
• Melaksanakan penggantian oli dan filter pada peralatan sesuai jadwal perawatan.
• Melakukan pemanasan berkala (warming up) genset untuk menjaga kesiapan operasional.
• Melaporkan setiap ketidaksesuaian, kerusakan, atau kondisi abnormal pada peralatan kepada atasan terkait.

Housekeeping, Safety & Compliance
• Menjaga kebersihan mesin, area kerja, dan lingkungan power house.
• Menerapkan prosedur Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) serta standar lingkungan perusahaan dalam seluruh aktivitas kerja.
• Memastikan seluruh kegiatan operasional dilakukan sesuai dengan SOP, instruksi kerja, dan regulasi yang berlaku.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
